name: Cryptographic Implementation Verification
description: A cryptographic primitive implementation (hash, HMAC, block cipher, stream cipher, KDF, checksum, or encoding) is actually run against its own documented official test vector(s); the claimed match is checked against the real output.
executionEnv: python3 (hashlib/hmac/zlib/base64 stdlib, pycryptodome for block ciphers)

fields.label: Official test vector(s)
fields.help: One or more ';'-separated Python statements: optional setup assignments followed by one or more '<call> == <expected>' comparisons.
